This isn’t a battle.
This isn’t a monster—
it’s something far more vile: human nature.

Beneath Sunset Inn, a failed experiment creates something that cannot be perceived.
No presence. No trace. Yet it seeps into minds, rewriting thought and memory.

Upstairs, Fern falls asleep—defenseless.
She has no idea something has already crossed the line.

When memories are altered and perception is twisted,
can she still trust what she sees… or who she believes?

This isn’t corruption—
it’s having everything taken without ever realizing it.
